findings.description: Ticker list from query parameter is processed without explicit validation; although storage uses parameterized queries, unexpected formats could lead to errors or injection if storage layer changes.
findings.remediation: Add ticker symbol validation/whitelisting and document that storage relies on parameterized queries.

findings.description: Strategy path segment is captured directly and switched; arbitrary strings reach the default case but could be logged or cause unexpected behavior.
findings.remediation: Validate strategy against a constant whitelist before the switch and reject unknown values.

findings.description: Error responses from the API may inadvertently include internal stack traces if http.Error or similar is used unfiltered.
findings.remediation: Use the defined error codes and writeError helper to ensure no stack traces are sent to clients.

findings.description: Sharpe ratio calculation assumes stddev may be zero; however, floating point edge cases could produce NaN if inputs are anomalous.
findings.remediation: Add explicit NaN checks and unit tests for series with constant prices.

findings.description: The HTTP request to Yahoo has no timeout set; a hanging or throttled request could lead to prolonged resource usage or accidental credential exposure in retry logs.
findings.remediation: Add a client HTTP timeout and exponential backoff retry; ensure no sensitive data is logged.
